description: This Java source file defines the 'Note' entity class used in the Fineract project, representing notes associated with clients, groups, loans, savings accounts, and share accounts. It includes methods for creating notes from JSON commands and various constructors for different note types.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing notes linked to various entities such as clients, groups, loans, savings accounts, and share accounts. Provides static factory methods for creating notes and methods for updating and querying notes.

methods.name: clientNoteFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Note for a client from JSON command input.

methods.name: groupNoteFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Note for a group from JSON command input.

methods.name: loanNote
methods.description: Creates a loan note with specified loan and note text.

methods.name: loanTransactionNote
methods.description: Creates a loan transaction note with specified loan, transaction, and note text.

methods.name: savingsTransactionNote
methods.description: Creates a savings account transaction note.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the note content based on JSON command input.

methods.name: isNotAgainstClientWithIdOf
methods.description: Checks if the note is not against a client with the specified ID.
